description: This file defines the SaveCustomerController class within the OrangeHRM Time plugin, responsible for handling the pre-render logic associated with customer data forms, switching components based on presence of an 'id' attribute in the request.

classes.name: SaveCustomerController
classes.description: Controller class that manages the pre-render setup of customer forms, switching between 'customer-edit' and 'customer-save' components depending on the request attributes.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Handles pre-render logic by determining whether to load an existing customer for editing or create a new customer form based on request data.
